<script>
(() => {
  const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  const finePointer = window.matchMedia('(pointer: fine)').matches;
  if (!finePointer || reduceMotion) return;

  const cursor = document.querySelector('.ui-cursor');
  const dot = cursor?.querySelector('.ui-cursor-dot');
  const ring = cursor?.querySelector('.ui-cursor-ring');
  const label = ring?.querySelector('b');
  if (!cursor || !dot || !ring) return;

  let mx = -100, my = -100, rx = -100, ry = -100;

  const render = () => {
    rx += (mx - rx) * 0.16;
    ry += (my - ry) * 0.16;
    dot.style.transform = `translate3d(${mx}px, ${my}px, 0)`;
    ring.style.transform = `translate3d(${rx}px, ${ry}px, 0)`;
    requestAnimationFrame(render);
  };

  window.addEventListener('pointermove', (event) => {
    mx = event.clientX;
    my = event.clientY;
    cursor.classList.add('is-visible');
  }, { passive: true });

  document.addEventListener('pointerover', (event) => {
    const interactive = event.target.closest(
      'a, button, input, textarea, select, [role="button"], [data-cursor-label]'
    );
    cursor.classList.toggle('is-active', Boolean(interactive));

    const text = event.target.closest('[data-cursor-label]')?.dataset.cursorLabel || '';
    if (label) label.textContent = text;
    cursor.classList.toggle('has-label', Boolean(text));
  });

  document.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
    cursor.classList.remove('is-visible');
  });

  render();
})();
</script></div>

(() => {
  const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  const finePointer = window.matchMedia('(pointer: fine)').matches;
  if (!finePointer || reduceMotion) return;

  const cursor = document.querySelector('.ui-cursor');

  let mx = -100, my = -100, rx = -100, ry = -100;
